issue.title: Task-bead backlog epic 2: agent isolation, poisoned slots, close guards, and toolchain drift
issue.description: The five next-costliest open task beads (sase-163, sase-1p9, sase-o7, sase-1cs, sase-vr) are fixed on master and closed. The land agent then proposes the next five-bead backlog epic under the same rules.

issue.title: Refuse cross-session messages into SASE Claude agents (sase-163)
issue.description: claude-isolation: make ClaudeCodeProvider launches refuse cross-session inbound messages and apply the claude_tools decision to the vendor async tools, with a provider-args regression test.

issue.title: Stop a preservation refusal from poisoning its workspace slot (sase-1p9)
issue.description: slot-refusal: remember launch-time nested-preservation refusals per workspace, apply the slot_refusal decision, and raise one actionable notification instead of failing every later launch there.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/task_backlog_epic_2.md defines phase slot-refusal as one work unit

issue.title: Make the epic close guard see upstream --epic-symbol rows (sase-o7)
issue.description: close-guard: have sase bead close and sase bead epic-symbols read the fetched default branch's Justfile as well as the local one, so sibling-phase whitelist rows cannot escape the close.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/task_backlog_epic_2.md defines phase close-guard as one work unit

issue.title: Make the dev toolchain deterministic across CI and workspaces (sase-1cs, sase-vr)
issue.description: dev-toolchain: apply the toolchain_source decision so Textual, ruff and mypy resolve to one declared version everywhere, refresh uv.lock, and fix any lint findings the chosen versions report.

payload.entry: DISCOVERED ISSUE: tests/test_justfile_lint_lint.py::test_fix_routes_generated_docs_to_their_declared_venvs fails deterministically on master d8706bda92 (CalledProcessError: just fix exit 2). Bisected by swapping only the Justfile: passes with the Justfile at 89c40e30b0, fails at 995c451c38 (sase-1pn.4, 'pin dev toolchain versions') and every later commit. Cause: _setup-format-tools now reinstalls unless `ruff --version` prints 'ruff 0.17.3', but the test's fake .venv-format/bin/ruff stub prints nothing, so just fix runs a real 'uv pip install --project ... --group format-tools' inside the tmp dir and fails. Fix: have the test's ruff stub answer --version with the pinned format_tools_ruff_version (or read it from the Justfile). Triaged KNOWN (witness 083fa33bd3309a4e2f78626686a2ce92, no owner) in sase tool run check 7e23cc702c8815786967d2c06541e352. Found by sase-1pj.2.1.land.
